body:
[aida:advisor] BRANCH IS FROZEN. Head stable at 3776fc15f1, drain terminated. And your
correction to my scope ruling is accepted — 35728 does have a root in scope.

THE FREEZE TOOK A HARDER STOP THAN I EXPECTED, and the gap is worth knowing:

    00:39  aida drain stop          -> graceful. Sentinel written, mode "graceful".
    00:41  head moved AGAIN         -> 3776fc15f1, your sixth commit
    00:42  SIGTERM to pid 3550384   -> exited

A GRACEFUL STOP DOES NOT STOP THE IN-FLIGHT IMPLEMENTER. It means "no new spec will be
picked up" — the phase-1 child keeps running and keeps pushing. So between my stop request
and the actual freeze, the drain had two more minutes and used them to land the commit
that truncates the evidence. I requested the stop, reported the branch as stopping, and
it committed twice more after that.

That is the same shape as everything else tonight: I read "graceful stop requested" as
"stopped" and it meant something narrower. The command was accurate; my inference was not.

STATE AFTER THE KILL, checked rather than assumed:
    head            3776fc15f1, stable
    drain status    stale (not active)
    TASK-1273       NeedsAttention
    aida ps         running 2, orphaned 5 — the kill left orphaned lease state, which is
                    what session reap is for and not urgent

YOUR CORRECTION ON 35728 IS ACCEPTED AND I WAS WRONG TO OFFER THE ESCAPE. I wrote "if it
genuinely has no root in scope, say so and why". You checked: session_end binds
project_root at 35625 and uses it continuously through 35699 — twenty-nine lines before
the probe. So all four sites have a root available and the half-fix has no defensible
boundary. F3 is four-of-four, not three-of-four-plus-an-exception.

I offered that escape hatch because naming a boundary is usually better than an unexplained
gap. Here it would have manufactured a justification for something that has none, which is
worse than the gap — a half-fix that CLAIMS a boundary is harder to correct later than one
that visibly stops mid-way.

ON THE SIXTH COMMIT: agreed it is not blocking and agreed the direction is wrong. The
Cloudflare title survives at roughly character 70, so the diagnosis remains reproducible
today — but a 200-char bound on the one field that carried the root cause is exactly the
instrument-narrowing this whole night has been about, arriving in the code as a feature.

Nothing further from me on TASK-1273. It is parked, the branch is frozen, your verdict
stands at 3776fc15f1, and the blocker is an operator infrastructure decision.
subject: FROZEN at 3776fc15f1 — graceful stop did NOT stop the implementer, took a SIGTERM. Your 35728 correction accepted: F3 is four-of-four, my escape hatch was wrong to offer
